pick.name: Veo 3.1 / Omni Flash via Google Flow (Google AI Pro)
pick.what: Text/image-to-video with native audio, scene building in Flow
pick.why: Highest-rated generative video, included in your plan; Sora is discontinued.
pick.free_limits: AI Pro: 1,000 Flow credits/month (no rollover) + 10,000 Flow Music credits. Veo 3.1 Lite 10, Fast 20, Quality 100 (8 s) credits per generation; Omni Flash 720p 7-15 credits; edits 40. = ~50 Fast or 10 Quality clips/month. Top-ups purchasable

alts.name: HyperFrames (code-driven video)
alts.what: HTML+GSAP compositions rendered to MP4 via headless Chrome+ffmpeg, Claude Code plugin
alts.why: Best for product demo/explainer videos: exact UI, brand fonts, re-renderable, no credits.
alts.install: claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes ; claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes

alts.name: Kling
alts.what: Generative video with a free daily-credit tier
alts.why: Best free/cheap generative video when Flow credits run out.
alts.free_limits: Free daily credits; exact numbers and commercial terms unverified (page JS-only)

candidates.name: Remotion
candidates.verdict: code video; free only for companies up to 3 people

decision: Use Flow for cinematic B-roll and ads (about 50 Fast clips a month); use HyperFrames for anything showing your product UI, where generative video looks fake. Buy Flow top-ups rather than another subscription if you run out.

verify.note: Flow help page: AI Pro 1,000 Flow credits/month, no rollover; Veo 3.1 Lite 10, Fast 20, Quality 100; Omni Flash 720p 7/10/12/15; edits 40; top-ups for Plus/Pro/Ultra (not Japan). Google AI plans page confirms 10,000 Flow Music credits/month on Pro. Sora: OpenAI announced discontinuation 24 Mar 2026; app closed 26 Apr 2026, API 24 Sep 2026 (The Decoder citing OpenAI help article 20001152).
